Everything that could've gone wrong on this New York trip has gone wrong. In the past 48 hours, Daniel Park and I have: - scraped idea after idea, rebuilding our plan as we walk to our next spot - got caught in a thunderstorm, sprinting to CVS to buy umbrellas - planned to get our first video out yesterday, had to postpone it - walked 30 mins to our filming spot, only to find out it's closed - missed subways, taken wrong turns, and gotten lost Yesterday, we got back to our hotel at 12am, looked at each other, both thinking "how has it only been 2 days". It's felt like ages. But 48 hours of constant problem solving teaches you a lot about the person next to you. The one thing I learned is that Daniel doesn't flinch at anything. Every setback, we pivot, figure out a solution, and deal with it head on. This is Day 2/14. I feel like we're on the cusp of our best work yet :)

From SaaS to services as software? I spent a lot of time thinking about how AI agents change the way we work, grow teams, and build businesses. One of the most exciting paradigm shifts we are seeing is that services businesses can finally scale like software. At PangeAI, we live this every day already - delivering bespoke spatial intelligence to large infrastructure operators, at a scale that would have required an army of consultants three years ago. More thoughts in my latest blogpost 👇 https://lnkd.in/diYv5KrY

3.6 million lines deleted. 10k added. Three months of work replaced in a week. This isn't an AI problem-it's a fundamentals problem. I've seen this pattern in AI-first teams before. Someone prompts their way to a working prototype, ships it, moves on. No architecture. No separation of concerns. Just vibes and velocity. Clean architecture actually makes AI-assisted iteration faster, not slower. When your codebase has structure, the AI has context. When it's chaos, you're generating more chaos. The tool didn't fail here. The engineering discipline did. 😐 #AI #SoftwareEngineering #CodeQuality #TechDebt #Architecture #EarlyCareerEngineers #MidLevelEngineers #CareerGrowth #EngineeringLeadership #SoftwareDevelopment #Founders #CTO #TechLeadership #AIEngineering #CleanCode
